instructor: Asst. Prof. Dr. Huda Lafta Majeed
subject: 01_Cyber_Security

questions.question: What does a security policy define?
options: Who is authorised, and what they may do.
How much each control costs the company.
Which vendor supplies the security tools.
When the last audit took place here.
options_ar: مَن المصرّح له، وما المسموح له به.
كم تكلفة كل ضابط أمني على الشركة.
أي مورّد يزوّد أدوات الأمن فعلاً.
متى جرى آخر تدقيق أمني في الشركة.
options_en: Who is authorised, and what they may do.
How much each control costs the company.
Which vendor supplies the security tools.
When the last audit took place here.
questions.explanation: A security policy states how security is implemented at each level, defining who is authorized to reach which assets and what they may do there.
questions.explanation_ar: سياسة الأمن تبيّن كيف يُنفَّذ الأمان في كل مستوى، فتحدّد مَن يصرّح له بالوصول لأي أصول وما يجوز له فعله.

questions.question: Why is free movement through all departments a security risk?
questions.question_ar: لماذا تُعدّ الحركة الحرة في كل الأقسام خطراً أمنياً؟
options: It raises the cost of the guards they hired.
It increases the temptation to take assets.
It slows down the network traffic badly.
It makes the audit trail harder to read.
options_ar: يزيد إغراء أخذ الأصول من الداخل.
يبطئ حركة الشبكة بشكل كبير جداً.
يجعل سجل التدقيق أصعب في القراءة.
options_en: It raises the cost of the guards they hired.
It increases the temptation to take assets.
It slows down the network traffic badly.
It makes the audit trail harder to read.
questions.explanation: When everyone can move freely inside, it becomes much harder to apply safeguards. That is the human nature of temptation.
questions.explanation_ar: لما يتحرك الجميع بحرية في الداخل، يصير تطبيق الضمانات أصعب بكثير. وهذه طبيعة الإنسان المتمثّلة في الإغراء.

questions.question: Besides temptation, what else does access control prevent?
questions.question_ar: إلى جانب الإغراء، ما الذي يمنعه التحكم بالوصول أيضاً؟
options: Only attacks arriving from outside.
Only failures of the network hardware.
Accidents, as well as temptation.
Only deliberate theft by insiders.
options_en: Only attacks arriving from outside.
Only failures of the network hardware.
Accidents, as well as temptation.
Only deliberate theft by insiders.
questions.explanation: Access control has two reasons: reducing temptation and preventing accidents.
questions.explanation_ar: للتحكم بالوصول سببان: تقليل الإغراء ومنع الحوادث.

questions.question: What does a door achieve on its own, without a lock?
questions.question_ar: ماذا يحقّق الباب وحده بدون قفل؟
options: It authenticates every single person.
It records who entered and when.
It stops a determined attacker too.
It only keeps honest people out.
options_ar: تتحقق من هوية كل شخص يدخل.
options_en: It authenticates every single person.
It records who entered and when.
It stops a determined attacker too.
It only keeps honest people out.
questions.explanation: The door is the physical barrier, but by itself it only keeps honest people out. The authentication function comes from the lock.
questions.explanation_ar: الباب هو الحاجز المادي، لكنه بحد ذاته يمنع الناس الصادقين فقط. ووظيفة المصادقة تأتي من القفل.

questions.question: What function does the lock provide?
options: The lock performs the authentication function.
The lock only delays a determined thief here.
The lock records each entry in a written log.
The lock replaces the whole security policy itself.
options_ar: القفل يسجّل كل دخول في سجل.
options_en: The lock performs the authentication function.
The lock only delays a determined thief here.
The lock records each entry in a written log.
The lock replaces the whole security policy itself.
questions.explanation: Holding the key means the person possesses or knows the information needed, so the lock is the authentication step of the door.
questions.explanation_ar: حمل المفتاح يعني أن الشخص يملك أو يعرف المعلومات المطلوبة، فالقفل هو خطوة المصادقة في الباب.

questions.question: How is a standard key-locking deadbolt engaged or withdrawn?
questions.question_ar: كيف يُفعَّل القفل المزلاجي القياسي أو يُسحب؟
options: It is opened by a fingerprint scan on site.
It is engaged and withdrawn with a key.
It is released by a code on a keypad.
It is released from a control room.
options_en: It is opened by a fingerprint scan on site.
It is engaged and withdrawn with a key.
It is released by a code on a keypad.
It is released from a control room.
questions.explanation: The key-locking deadbolt works by key. It adds security to manually operated doors and comes with a single or double cylinder.
questions.explanation_ar: القفل المزلاجي بالمفتاح يعمل بالمفتاح. ويضيف أماناً للأبواب التي تُشغَّل يدوياً، ويتوفر بأسطوانة مفردة أو مزدوجة.

questions.question: What is the solenoid-operated deadbolt used for?
questions.question_ar: فيمَ يُستخدم القفل المزلاجي المدفوع بالـ solenoid؟
options: It works with a personal code on a keypad.
It works with a guard standing nearby.
It works electronically as an auxiliary.
It works with a key as the main lock.
options_en: It works with a personal code on a keypad.
It works with a guard standing nearby.
It works electronically as an auxiliary.
It works with a key as the main lock.
questions.explanation: The solenoid deadbolt is electronically operated and is used as an auxiliary lock on doors where access control is wanted.
questions.explanation_ar: القفل المزلاجي بالـ solenoid يُشغَّل إلكترونياً ويُستخدم كقفل مساعد على الأبواب التي يُراد فيها التحكم بالوصول.

questions.question: What does a cipher lock require before it releases the door?
questions.question_ar: ماذا يشترط القفل الشفري قبل أن يفتح الباب؟
options: A physical key cut for that door.
A badge read by a sensor fixed nearby.
A guard who recognises the person.
A personal code entered on a keypad.
options_ar: مفتاح معدني مقطوع لذلك الباب بعينه.
شارة يقرأها حساس قريب من الباب.
كود شخصي يُدخَل على لوحة المفاتيح.
options_en: A physical key cut for that door.
A badge read by a sensor fixed nearby.
A guard who recognises the person.
A personal code entered on a keypad.
questions.explanation: The cipher lock opens when the correct programmed code is typed on its keypad, and it is often used in access-control systems.
questions.explanation_ar: القفل الشفري يفتح عندما يُدخَل الكود المبرمج الصحيح على لوحة مفاتيحه، ويُستخدم غالباً في أنظمة التحكم بالوصول.

questions.question: What do access-control gates control?
options: They control the ingress and egress of it.
They authenticate people using a keypad.
They record every movement in a written log.
They replace the locks on the inner doors.
options_ar: تسجّل كل حركة في سجل مكتوب.
تغني عن الأقفال على الأبواب الداخلية.
options_en: They control the ingress and egress of it.
They authenticate people using a keypad.
They record every movement in a written log.
They replace the locks on the inner doors.
questions.explanation: A gate is a barrier swung, drawn or lowered to control ingress and egress through a wall or fence. Sliding gates are used where safety and security demands are high.
questions.explanation_ar: البوابة حاجز يُدار أو يُسحب أو يُنزَل للتحكم بالدخول والخروج عبر جدار أو سياج. والبوابات المنزلقة تُستخدم حيث تكون متطلبات السلامة والأمن عالية.

questions.question: What is authentication?
options: Recording which assets were touched today.
Encrypting the traffic between two remote sites.
Proving that someone is who they claim to be.
Deciding what an authenticated user may do.
options_ar: تسجيل الأصول التي مُسّت اليوم فعلاً.
إثبات أن الشخص هو من يدّعي أنه هو.
تحديد ما يجوز للمستخدم المصرّح فعله.
options_en: Recording which assets were touched today.
Encrypting the traffic between two remote sites.
Proving that someone is who they claim to be.
Deciding what an authenticated user may do.
questions.explanation: Authentication establishes identity, and authorization is built on top of it. Deciding what the user may do is authorization, not authentication.
questions.explanation_ar: المصادقة تثبت الهوية، والتصريح يُبنى فوقها. أما تحديد ما يجوز للمستخدم فعله فهو تصريح لا مصادقة.

questions.question: Which factor is something you know?
options: Somewhere you are, such as a room.
Something you know, such as a password.
Something you have, such as a badge you carry.
Something you are, such as a face.
options_en: Somewhere you are, such as a room.
Something you know, such as a password.
Something you have, such as a badge you carry.
Something you are, such as a face.
questions.explanation: Knowledge is something you know, or something only the designated person should know: a password or a PIN.
questions.explanation_ar: المعرفة شيء تعرفه، أو شيء لا ينبغي أن يعرفه إلا الشخص المعني: كلمة مرور أو رقم سري.

questions.question: Which factor is something you have?
options: Something you know, such as a PIN.
Something you are, such as a fingerprint.
Somewhere you are, such as a site.
Something you have, such as a token.
options_en: Something you know, such as a PIN.
Something you are, such as a fingerprint.
Somewhere you are, such as a site.
Something you have, such as a token.
questions.explanation: Possession is something you have, or something only the designated person should have: an access card or a security token.
questions.explanation_ar: الحيازة شيء تملكه، أو شيء لا ينبغي أن يملكه إلا الشخص المعني: بطاقة وصول أو رمز أمان.

questions.question: Which factor covers a fingerprint?
options: Something you are, such as a fingerprint.
Something you know, such as a password.
Something you have, such as a card you carry.
Somewhere you are, such as an office.
options_en: Something you are, such as a fingerprint.
Something you know, such as a password.
Something you have, such as a card you carry.
Somewhere you are, such as an office.
questions.explanation: It is called Inheritance here: something you are, or something only the designated person is. The standard term is inherence, or biometrics.
questions.explanation_ar: يُسمّى هنا الوراثة: شيء تكونه، أو شيء لا يكونه إلا الشخص المعني. والمصطلح القياسي هو inherence أي الخصائص الحيوية.

questions.question: Which factor is somewhere you are?
questions.question_ar: أي عامل هو مكان تتواجد فيه؟
options: Something you are, such as a fingerprint.
Somewhere you are, such as a specific site.
Something you know, such as a password.
Something you have, such as a small token.
options_ar: مكان تتواجد فيه، مثل موقع محدد.
شيء تعرفه أنت، مثل كلمة المرور.
options_en: Something you are, such as a fingerprint.
Somewhere you are, such as a specific site.
Something you know, such as a password.
Something you have, such as a small token.
questions.explanation: Location is somewhere you are, or somewhere only the designated person is, such as a specific room or site.
questions.explanation_ar: الموقع مكان تتواجد فيه، أو مكان لا يتواجد فيه إلا الشخص المعني، مثل غرفة أو موقع محدد.
